read.title: Pet care itemised: feeding, water, supplies, exercise, grooming, the vet, insurance, housing, sitters, airlines, entry rules
read.companionFile: docs/research/world/research-pets-property.json (2026-10-03) already holds adoption fees, licences, Banfield office visits and rabies for LA/New Haven, Medivet Greenwich, Donnybrook/Dublin Bay Vets, My Animal/Juno (Toronto), BC SPCA Vancouver hospital, Agatan CDMX, Rover walk averages and London/Toronto/Vancouver house-sitting averages, Delta/American/United/Air Canada/Aer Lingus/BA/Aeromexico cabin rules, hotel pet fees, PDSA/Rover/ASPCA annual-cost figures. This file adds to it and does not repeat those rows except where a fresher or fuller figure was read.

status.verified: read on the publisher's own page, PDF or structured product data (several retailer pages were read with curl and their schema.org Product/Offer JSON-LD or server-rendered listing parsed, because WebFetch was blocked; the note says so)
status.secondhand: a search-engine summary or third-party page; the primary page was blocked or not found. Treat as unconfirmed.
status.estimate: a modeled figure; the derivation is given. Never present as a published figure.

read.priceNotes: Retail prices are the online list price at the time read, before delivery and before subscription/autoship discounts unless stated. Walmart.com, PetSmart.ca, zooplus.co.uk/.ie and Petco Mexico are national online prices, not a named store in the town; the town gets the national price. Petco Mexico shows a promotional 'now' price, a struck-through regular 'before' price and a lower third figure (apparently a member/subscription price); all three are recorded.

housing.rule: No federal cap on pet deposits or pet rent. Market averages 2025: pet rent USD 35.65/month; refundable pet deposit about USD 300; non-refundable pet fee about USD 315
housing.note: RentCafe analysis, October 2025. Assistance animals (FHA) are exempt from pet fees.

housing.rule: Security deposit plus any advance capped at one month's rent (GOL 7-108, HSTPA 2019); a separate pet deposit cannot push the total past one month. NYC Admin Code 27-2009.1: in a building of 3+ units, a no-pet lease clause is waived if the pet is kept openly for 3 months and the landlord, knowing, does not start proceedings
housing.status: verified (NYC pet law on nyc.gov); secondhand (GOL 7-108, justia 403)

housing.rule: From 2024-07-01 (AB 12, Civil Code 1950.5) total security deposit, however named and including a pet deposit, is capped at one month's rent; small landlords (natural persons/LLC of persons, at most 2 properties and 4 units) may take two months. Pet rent is rent, not security
housing.status: verified (cap and exception); secondhand (pet deposit counts toward the cap)

housing.rule: Security deposit max two months' rent (one month if tenant 62+) under CGS 47a-21; a pet deposit may be asked in addition, except for a disabled tenant's service animal

Tenant Fees Act 2019 Sch.1 para 2: deposit max 5 weeks' rent (annual rent under GBP 50,000) or 6 weeks; no separate pet deposit beyond the cap. Renters' Rights Act 2025 s.11: tenant may request a pet in writing; consent 'not to be unreasonably refused'; landlord answers within 28 days (extendable). Pet provisions in force 2026-05-01 (secondhand). Whether a landlord may require pet insurance after the Act is disputed in secondary sources

Deposit max one month's rent and advance rent max one month (from 2022); no separate pet deposit on top. Landlords may refuse pets in the lease; apartment owners' management companies may have house rules

RTA 2006 s.14: a tenancy-agreement provision prohibiting animals is void. Landlords may take only a last-month's-rent deposit (and a key deposit); the LTB has refused pet deposits. A tenant can still be removed for a pet that causes serious allergies, damage, danger or substantial interference, or breaches a valid condominium declaration
housing.note: ontario.ca/laws renders by script; text not read.

housing.rule: Security deposit max half of the first month's rent; if pets are allowed, a pet damage deposit max half of the first month's rent regardless of number of pets, payable at start or when the pet arrives. Landlords may refuse pets

Reform to Article 4 of the Ley de Vivienda para la Ciudad de Mexico, in force 2025-10-28: renting or selling cannot be refused because a person lives with companion animals; refusal must be justified by documented actual or potential harm. Condominium rules (Ley de Propiedad en Condominio art. 21) may restrict animals that by number, size or nature affect safety, health or comfort. Complaints: PROSOC, COPRED
housing.status: verified (UNAM Global summary of the reform; Gaceta text not read)

entryRules.rules: microchip before rabies vaccine; travel at least 21 full days after the primary rabies vaccination; pet travel document (animal health certificate or pet passport, depending on origin); dogs treated for tapeworm 24 h-5 days before arrival; must use an approved route (not needed within the UK or from Ireland); breach may mean up to 4 months' quarantine or refusal if by sea
entryRules.note: Approved airline routes are hold/cargo; pets other than assistance dogs do not fly in the cabin into GB (secondhand).

entryRules.rules: microchip; valid rabies vaccination; EU pet passport (EU residents) or EU health certificate (others; GB-issued EU passports invalid since 2021-01-01); dogs need praziquantel tapeworm treatment by a vet 24-120 h before arrival unless coming from Finland, Malta, Norway or Northern Ireland
entryRules.note: pettravel.gov.ie certificate mismatch on fetch; search summary of gov.ie.

entryRules.rules: from 2024-08-01 every dog must appear healthy, be at least 6 months old, be microchipped, and carry a CDC Dog Import Form receipt (valid 6 months, multiple entries, for dogs only in rabies-free/low-risk countries in the last 6 months); dogs from high-risk countries need more

dogs and cats 3 months+ need a rabies vaccination certificate; inspection fee CAD 36.95 first animal + 6.16 each extra (from 2026-03-31) does not apply to arrivals from the US; a vaccination order costs CAD 67.75 + 36.95; commercial dogs from high dog-rabies-risk countries barred since 2022-09-28

physical inspection by SENASICA on arrival and a Certificado Zoosanitario para Importacion issued at the port; from Canada no health certificate or vaccine record needed; from the US dogs need USDA-accredited vet documentation of freedom from screwworm within 5 days (cats exempt), no health certificate; from elsewhere a health certificate issued within 15 days showing rabies vaccination and deworming within 6 months; parasite treatment at owner's cost
